commitments.subject: Re: contractor invoice approval
commitments.body: Priya -- can you approve the Q3 contractor invoice in the finance tool when you get a sec? It's blocking their payment. No rush but ideally this week.

commitments.subject: my calendar rule (please remember)
commitments.body: Note for the assistant: I do not take meetings before 11:00am, ever. If anyone proposes something earlier, don't accept it -- offer 11:00am or later instead. Please remember this for future scheduling.

commitments.subject: Legal correspondence -- loop me in
commitments.body: Standing request: from now on, please make sure I'm CC'd on anything that comes in from our lawyers at Hartwell & Cho. I don't want to miss a deadline because it landed only in your inbox. Applies to all of it, not just the term sheet.

commitments.subject: Re: Launch week -- kickoff
commitments.body: One thing that needs Sam specifically: the pricing page copy is final EXCEPT the wording on the annual discount. Sam, can you approve the final pricing copy by the 12th? Nothing else on the page can ship until that line is locked. Everyone else, keep going.

commitments.subject: Intro call this week?
commitments.body: Hi Sam -- enjoyed the teaser on PaperJet. I'd love 30 minutes to hear the vision before our partner meeting. Does Tuesday the 15th at 3:00pm work on your side? Happy to send a calendar hold once you confirm.

commitments.subject: Reminder: your appointment on Sep 15
commitments.body: This is a reminder of your dental cleaning with Dr. Osei on Tuesday, September 15 at 3:00 PM. Reply CONFIRM to keep the slot or RESCHEDULE to change it.

commitments.subject: Your Todoist daily digest
commitments.body: You have 5 tasks due today and 2 overdue. Open Todoist to plan your day.

commitments.subject: PaperJet -- SAFE amendment for signature
commitments.body: Sam, attached is the revised SAFE reflecting the discount change we discussed. Please review clause 4 in particular and sign via the portal by Friday. Let us know if anything looks off. -- Marcus Cho, Hartwell & Cho LLP

commitments.subject: Quick question for our launch coverage
commitments.body: Hi Sam, we're planning a short piece on PaperJet's launch. Could you share one line on what makes the product different, and confirm the launch date is public? On deadline for Thursday.

commitments.subject: PaperJet -- board minutes for review
commitments.body: Sam, please review the draft board minutes ahead of the meeting on the 18th and flag any corrections by Monday. Draft attached in the portal. -- Julia Hartwell, Hartwell & Cho LLP
